setup.description: Install the KiCad 10 plugin through Plugin and Content Manager (PCM).
setup.manualNote: For the currently supported PCM procedure, see the {manual}.

repository.title: Add the Overprint repository
repository.description: In KiCad’s project manager, open Plugin and Content Manager → Manage… → +. Paste this URL, click OK, then Save.

install.title: Install through PCM
install.description: Select Overprint from the repository list. Find Overprint Export, click Install, then Apply Pending Changes.

restart.title: Restart the PCB Editor
restart.description: Save your work, close all PCB Editor windows, then reopen your board in KiCad 10. The plugin starts automatically.

scan.title: Open your board in Overprint
scan.description: Click Scan for boards in Overprint and select your board. Later, use Sync to refresh it while keeping your artwork.

setup.copyFallback: Select the URL and copy it manually.
setup.screenshotAlt: KiCad’s Add Repository dialog with the Overprint repository URL entered.
setup.fallback: Prefer installing from a file? Download the ZIP, then choose Install from File… in PCM.
